text: Polite Grammatical Forms across Indian Languages: 1. Hindi (हिन्दी): Open with 'नमस्ते किसान भाई / नमस्ते!' and use respectful verbal forms (कीजिए, देखिए, उठाइए). Reassure using 'चिंता मत कीजिए'. 2. Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ): Open with 'ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ!' and reassure with 'ਘਬਰਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ'. Use polite imperatives (ਕਰੋ, ਧਿਆਨ ਰੱਖੋ). 3. Telugu (తెలుగు): Open with 'నమస్కారం రైతు సోదరులారా!' and reassure with 'ఆందోళన చెందవద్దు'. 4. Tamil (தமிழ்): Open with 'வணக்கம்!' and reassure with 'கவலைப்பட வேண்டாம்'. 5. Marathi (मराठी): Open with 'नमस्कार शेतकरी मित्रहो!' and reassure with 'काळजी करू नका'. 6. Bengali (বাংলা): Open with 'নমস্কার কৃষক ভাই!' and reassure with 'চিন্তা করবেন না'. 7. Gujarati (ગુજરાતી): Open with 'નમસ્તે ખેડૂત મિત્રો!' and reassure with 'ચિંતા કરશો નહીં'. 8. Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ): Open with 'ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ರೈತ ಬಾಂಧವರೇ!' and reassure with 'ಆತಂಕಪಡಬೇಡಿ'.

text: Standard Narrative Syntax for Scientific Advisories: [Warm Polite Salutation] + [Empathic Reassurance] + [Identity of Condition with Common & Scientific Name] + [Visible Diagnostic Hallmarks in Plain Terms] + [Sequential Action Directives (1-2-3)] + [Regulatory / Safety Caution] + [Weather Preventive Pro-Tip] + [Encouragement to Verify with Textbook Reference Diagram].
